An '''officer''' was an [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]] in the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]]. During the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the officer was part of a small Imperial task force [[Mission to Gibbela|sent]] to the remote [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Gibbela]] to conquer the planet for the Empire. Expecting little resistance, the taskforce landed in a [[Sentinel-class landing craft/Legends|''Sentinel''-class landing craft]] in the middle of a [[Dazouri|native's]] crops. The officer and several [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] disembarked the [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] and confronted a small, weak [[Unidentified Dazouri farmer|farmer]], demanding surrender from the [[Farmer/Legends|farmer]]. Angered by the Imperial's intrusion, the farmer transformed into a large, claw creature and attacked the Imperial [[Troop/Legends|troops]], killing them all.
